assign.request: UX reviewer pass on /imagine/research/ - rethink the page, try an alternative layout, measure, keep or revert, make it more visual, check persistence, land.

log.msg: FIVE SENTENCES (before). what: a live research hub on ancient-technology mysteries, four topics dug in parallel, every claim rated established/contested/fringe/speculation. use: pick one of four topic cards, or open a closed disclosure lower down for the raw stream. goal: leave knowing what is actually known and how sure anyone is. hard: 2/5 - the depth crisis is fixed (877px at 3440, was 14413px) but the four topic cards are pure stat tiles (a count, a bar) with zero real claims visible; a stranger sees HOW MUCH research exists, never WHAT it found. better: show one real, sourced, credence-tagged claim per topic on the front itself, not just a count of how many exist.

ALTERNATIVE LAYOUT: built the owner's 3-column card (public/imagine/layouts/LayoutsCard.js is the prior art for the same shape) for each topic - left: name + tally + link out, centre: the topic's own newest theory rendered live (title, credence badge, reasoning, source), right: credence counts as labelled readouts. Replaces topic_cards()/topic_card(); board() (the old global, re-grouped-by-topic theories section) is deleted, its job now lives inside each card so scrolling from one topic to the next shows the relation. stream() (Latest, cross-topic chronological) is untouched.

MEASUREMENT TRAP FOUND: a closed <details>'s children report real non-zero getBoundingClientRect() geometry in this Chromium (positioned as if open) even though nothing paints and the <details> element's own rect is correctly small. The brief's literal box-union recipe read maxBoxBottom past 9000px on a page that visibly ends before 900px. Fixed by filtering with el.checkVisibility({checkVisibilityCSS:true}) or reading the actual content wrapper's (.research-program) own rect. The corrected before-number (877px at 3440) matches the 2026-09-04 review card's own claimed figure exactly, which validated the method. Documented in doc/decisions.md and this realm's readme.md so the next agent measuring a disclosure-heavy page does not repeat it.

NUMBERS (.research-program's own rect, checkVisibility-filtered): width used 3440 46.0% -> 46.0% (unchanged - width is bounded by the column's width:"large", and this exact page already tried width:"fill" and reverted it 2026-09-04; widening a column is never the fix for dead space per the layout skill). dead space 3440 1856px -> 1856px (unchanged, same reason). page height 1280: 734px -> 2291px. page height 3440: 877px -> 2855px. Height roughly tripled - the one number that argued for reverting.

DECISION: KEPT. Height grew but stayed bounded (2855px at 3440 is under two screens, nowhere near the 14413px crisis the 2026-09-04 depth fix addressed) and every added pixel is one real sourced claim, not raw unfiltered entries. The five-sentence read is the deciding evidence: before, "how do I use it" had no honest answer beyond click-and-hope; after, the front answers its own stated question (what do we actually know) once per topic, with zero clicks. Invariants checked at both widths: no content at x:0 (pass), no prose past the measure (pass - the stage column is narrower than --measure already), no framed box touching a container edge (pass - .rfront-card sits on the column's own padded track).

UI-TEST caught a real bug before landing: the first build's "+N more theories" was an in-page <details> that dumped ALL remaining theories inline - clicking it on Stone grew .rfront-stage by 5412px in one step (measured by drive.mjs), exactly the "massive shift" the owner's paging note warns against. Fixed to a plain link to the topic's own page (matching the original board()'s pattern), re-tested: click now correctly opens /imagine/research/stone/ as a sibling column, no inline dump. Re-verified with a second ui-test run.
PERSISTENCE: grep -rn store()|localStorage across public/imagine/research/ - no matches. This realm persists nothing; no baseline mark needed. Recorded in readme.md.
CONSOLE: zero console errors at 1280 and 3440, before and after, checked via headless Playwright (page.on('console')/'pageerror').

PRE-EXISTING PAPER CUT (not fixed, out of scope): the KIND_ICON glyphs (Program.js, e.g. account_tree) render as two small overlapping shapes rather than the intended icon on both the front and topic subpages (verified identical on /imagine/research/stone/, so not introduced by this pass). Likely a Material Icons font/ligature issue in ext/Research or the shared icon() helper; would need a proposal against ext/Research/Program.js or core's icon() to fix, and is unrelated to this task's layout work.

FIVE SENTENCES (after). what: a live research hub on ancient-technology mysteries, four topics dug in parallel, each card leading with one real credence-tagged claim. use: read a topic card's own theory right on the front, or click its name/"open the full dig"/"N more theories" to go deeper, or open "Latest" for the raw cross-topic stream. goal: leave knowing at least one real, sourced claim per topic and how sure anyone is about it, not just how many claims exist. hard: 2/5 - the one open question is that the shown theory is always the newest, not necessarily the most interesting; a reader has to click "+N more" to know if a better one is hiding. better: rank the highlighted theory by how contested/discussed it is rather than defaulting to newest.

assign.outcome:
**Topic cards went from stat tiles to the owner's 3-column card — kept, height cost measured and accepted.** `/imagine/research/`'s four topic cards used to show only a count and a coloured bar; now each is left (name + tally + link out) / centre (the topic's own newest theory, live, full reasoning and source) / right (credence readouts) — the same shape `/imagine/layouts/`'s catalogue already uses. `board()` (the old global, re-grouped-by-topic theories section) is gone; its job lives inside each card now. Measured at `.research-program`'s own rect (checkVisibility-filtered — see the trap below): width used and dead space unchanged (46.0%, 1856px at 3440 — this column already tried `width:"fill"` and reverted it 2026-09-04); page height roughly tripled (877px→2855px at 3440, 734px→2291px at 1280). Kept anyway: still under two screens, nowhere near the 14,413px crisis the depth fix addressed, and every added pixel is a real sourced claim. ui-test caught a real bug first — the initial "+N more theories" was an in-page `<details>` that dumped 22 theories inline (+5,412px in one click); fixed to a link to the topic's own page and re-verified. Zero console errors at 1280/3440. Persists nothing (no baseline mark needed). Found and documented a measurement trap: a closed `<details>`'s children report real, non-zero `getBoundingClientRect()` geometry in this Chromium — the brief's literal box-union recipe overcounts by 10x on any disclosure-heavy page; fixed with `checkVisibility({checkVisibilityCSS:true})`.

Left open: the highlighted theory is always the newest, not the most contested/interesting one. Not fixed: a pre-existing icon-font glyph issue in `ext/Research`'s `KIND_ICON` (out of realm fences, unrelated to layout).
